question:
Which of the following clubs is playing in the i-League 2023 / 24?

I. Punjab FC

II. Mohammedan Sporting Club
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punjab FC** is not playing in the i-League 2023 / 24.
 
• **Mohammedan Sporting Club** is playing in the i-League 2023 / 24.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is **option 3**, which states that **Only II** (Mohammedan Sporting Club) is playing in the i-League 2023 / 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The i-League is one of the top professional football leagues in India.
 
• It was founded in 2007 and has been a platform for clubs across the country to compete at a high level.
 
• Teams participating in the i-League are subject to promotion and relegation based on their performance each season.
 
• The league has been instrumental in the development of football in India, providing opportunities for players, coaches, and clubs to showcase their talent.
